items.summary: Risk disposition: BLOCKED for SearchWoot public beta or full launch; CONDITIONAL for ordinary reversible fleet growth. Keep SearchWoot private and do not send rights outreach. Evidence: Woot documentation confirms API access mechanics only; public terms do not evidence redistribution, commercial/public display, historical derivatives, caching, or alerts. All four legal launch-readiness tasks remain open. Fleet compliance is technical-only: 35 pass, 20 fail, 6 unknown, with 20 banner/consent/GA4 findings and 4 privacy/terms findings. Security, accuracy/freshness, measurement, attribution, and owner gates also remain incomplete. Exact decision: preserve private launch containment, allow only reversible work that adds no new data collection, credentials, permissions, dependencies, cross-site behavior, or unsupported claims, and require human counsel before any rights outreach, affiliate/advertising use, public data display, or launch disposition change.

Launch-readiness progress: 0 of 4 legal tasks are evidenced closed. Source-rights evidence is documented but supports access only; data-flow and consent evidence are partial; logs, vendors, incident, deletion, correction, and request workflows remain unevidenced. Do not close tasks based on proposals, repository references, or technical baseline scans. Next evidence action: attach one dated read-only bundle covering the repository/config data-flow table, retention and deletion behavior, deployed consent capture, GA4 property/data-sharing and retention settings, log-field inventory, vendor terms/DPA status, and incident/request procedures.

Compliance and monetization disposition: do not block ordinary growth solely because telemetry is incomplete, but do not claim revenue, ROI, causal lift, or site attribution. Amazon evidence covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission; the commission remains unattributed. Any affiliate work must preserve existing disclosures, use registered tracking identifiers, and retain disclosure placement adjacent to applicable links. Compliance failures and unknowns require mapped remediation evidence before launch or material monetization expansion.
